mapper.select:
SELECT A.ITEMID , A.ITEM_NM , A.ITEMALIAS_NM , A.ITEMEXPLAN_DESC , A.DATATYPE_CD , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '102' AND CODE = A.DATATYPE_CD ) AS DATATYPE_NM , ( SELECT LGON_ID FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID::TEXT = A.UPDATE_USERID ) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , ( SELECT LGON_ID FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID::TEXT = A.FIRSTREG_USERID ) AS FIRSTREG_USERID , ( SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS FIRSTREG_DATETIME , A.ITEM_USE_YN , A.IFID , B.USED_CNT FROM RULEITEM A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEMID , COUNT(DISTINCT RULEID) AS USED_CNT FROM ( SELECT RULEID , SUBSTR(OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT WHERE DATATYPE_CD = '3' AND OBJECT_DATA LIKE '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT B.RULEID , SUBSTR(B.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(B.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT B WHERE B.DATATYPE_CD = '3' AND B.OBJECT_DATA LIKE '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT B.RULEID , B.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM B ) C GROUP BY ITEMID ) B ON A.ITEMID = B.ITEMID WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.IFID IN (#{ifid}, 'IF00000000')
AND A.ITEM_USE_YN = #{itemUseYn}
AND A.ITEM_NM LIKE '%' || #{itemNm} || '%'
AND A.ITEMALIAS_NM LIKE '%' || #{itemAliasNm} || '%'
SELECT ITEMID , ITEM_NM , ITEMALIAS_NM , ITEMEXPLAN_DESC , DATATYPE_CD , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME , ITEM_USE_YN , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME FROM RULEITEM WHERE ITEMID = #{value}
SELECT ITEMID , ITEMREF_CD , ITEMREF_NM , ITEMREFALIAS_NM , ITEMREFEXPR_DESC , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULEITEMREF WHERE ITEMID = #{value}
SELECT RULEID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT WHERE OBJECT_DATA = #{value} AND DATATYPE_CD = '3'
SELECT RULEID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT WHERE OBJECT_DATA = #{value} AND DATATYPE_CD = '3'
SELECT RULEID , RULE_NM , RULE_STATE , ACTIVATE_YN FROM RULE WHERE RULEID = #{value}
